claim: Frozen ESM-C (RT) and RiNALMo (ncRNA) representations contain shared structure that identifies the observed ncRNA partner far above chance among random candidates
supporting_analysis: 50-way retrieval, rung 1, regularized CCA (M-CCA) vs trivial baselines; permutation failure control
dataset_population: frozen test fold of PAIR-ELIG: 4,638 pairs / 357 components
result_estimate: MRR 0.4407 [0.4039, 0.4772] vs chance 0.0900; top-1 0.1714; permutation null mean 0.0901, p = 0.0005; reverse direction 0.4738 [0.4380, 0.5104]
limitations: Random candidates are a weak control; the effect is consistent with retron-type structure alone. n_eff = 14.1, not 4,638.

claim: The cross-modal advantage over the strongest trivial baseline survives control for length and GC composition
supporting_analysis: Rung 2 (length- and GC-matched candidates), paired per-component difference M-CCA - B-kmer against a pre-declared margin rule
dataset_population: test fold, rung-2 eligible: 4,380 pairs / 316 components
result_estimate: M-CCA 0.2262 [0.1972, 0.2565] vs B-kmer 0.1418; difference +0.0844 [+0.0503, +0.1187] (passes the pre-declared stop rule)
limitations: Does not separate retron-type structure from partner-level information.

claim: Retron type is independently recoverable from each modality alone, which supplies a sufficient route for any cross-modal method to score observed pairs highly without partner information
supporting_analysis: Multinomial logistic probe on frozen pooled embeddings, fit on training components, reported on test components
result_estimate: ESM-C RT 0.4978; RiNALMo ncRNA 0.6557; majority-class rate 0.2693
limitations: Explanatory, not a demonstration that type is the only route; a probe accuracy is not a causal decomposition.

claim: Local organization of the shared cross-modal space is substantially type-associated rather than demonstrably pair-specific
supporting_analysis: Neighbourhood analysis in the shared CCA space over the open candidate pool
dataset_population: test fold, open pool of 2,756 distinct ncRNAs
result_estimate: nearest cross-modal neighbour is the observed partner for 0.56 % of queries; median rank 238 of 2,756; 51.9 % of nearest neighbours share the query's retron type vs 9.4 % prevalence (5.32x)
limitations: Descriptive; no interval; rank statistics depend on the pool definition.

claim: Retrieval evidence does NOT establish partner-specific information beyond retron type: with type-matched candidates the cross-modal probe is not distinguishable from a k-mer baseline
supporting_analysis: Rung 3 (retron-type-matched candidates), paired per-component difference against the pre-declared margin
dataset_population: test fold, rung-3 eligible: 4,410 pairs / 299 components
result_estimate: M-CCA 0.1832 [0.1550, 0.2126] vs B-kmer 0.1534; difference +0.0298, 95 % CI [-0.0048, +0.0633] - fails the pre-declared stop rule
limitations: Absence of a distinguishable difference is NOT equivalence: the interval admits a true improvement up to +0.063. Power is limited at n_eff 14.1.

claim: Harder candidate rungs (same ncRNA cluster, same RT cluster, same species) cannot adjudicate partner specificity in this population
supporting_analysis: Rungs 4-6 of the candidate ladder, reported as UNDETERMINED rather than as nulls
dataset_population: test fold; rung pools spanning 1, 10 and 22 independent components
result_estimate: rung 4: 1 component (degenerate); rung 5: 10; rung 6: 22 - all below the component support confirmatory inference requires
limitations: Absence of sufficient measurement, not measured absence. Reporting these as nulls would be a category error.

claim: Conditioning an ncRNA sequence model on retron type improves held-out ncRNA likelihood over no conditioning
supporting_analysis: X2 arms T vs U, identical decoder, paired per-component NLL difference (X1 reported the same contrast on one fold)
limitations: Broad-association claim only. Conditioning on RT lineage does better still (G - U = -0.04256), so the type label is not the whole of the lineage signal.

claim: Conditioning on the specific RT representation improves held-out ncRNA likelihood beyond retron-type conditioning
supporting_analysis: X2 primary endpoint: pooled out-of-fold component-level R - T under 5-fold component-blocked cross-fitting (X1 pilot reported the same contrast on a single fold)
dataset_population: all 1,075 relatedness components of PAIR-ELIG, each evaluated out-of-fold exactly once (30,924 pairs)
result_estimate: R - T = -0.02470 [-0.02907, -0.02037]; 64.9 % of components favour R (X1: -0.01778, 65.0 %); same sign in all 5 folds, every fold interval excluding zero; three seeds -0.02470 / -0.03674 / -0.02093; near-duplicate-excluded -0.02532 [-0.03410, -0.01682]
limitations: Small in absolute terms (~1.8 % of the NLL). MOST of it is lineage-level, not pair-specific (C-25). INTERNAL cross-fitted confirmation on the same 30,924-pair population that produced X1 - not external validation. Not demonstrated in the quartile least similar to training RTs (C-26).

claim: The observed RT gives higher likelihood for its observed ncRNA than alternative RTs do, and the advantage decays sharply as the alternative becomes more similar
supporting_analysis: X2 counterfactual tiers C1-C4 (evaluation only; admissibility and similarity rules frozen before any estimate)
dataset_population: out-of-fold eligible pairs per tier: C1 30,796 / C2 29,459 / C3 30,922 / C4 29,186 pairs over 1,019 / 832 / 1,073 / 451 components
limitations: Statistical non-zero at C3/C4 does not mean substantive discrimination: at C3 only 52.5 % of PAIRS favour the observed RT (60.7 % at C4). Alternatives are conditioning controls, never biological negatives. A headline built on C1 alone would overstate pairing specificity by about an order of magnitude.
status: SUPPORTED (WEAK at C3, VERY SMALL at C4)

claim: The RT-specific advantage holds in the independently recurrent tier (T4), where a repeated observation is a repeated biological event rather than repeated deposition
supporting_analysis: X2 prespecified T4 stratum, out-of-fold (X1 reported the same stratum on one fold and could not resolve it)
limitations: The DESIGN predicted prospectively that T4 might remain unresolved because cross-fitting raises coverage 83 -> 247 components while n_eff moves 9.0 -> 8.6; that prediction was wrong in the favourable direction and is retained in the record. R - G within T4 is much smaller (-0.00499 [-0.00945, -0.00055]).
status: SUPPORTED (resolved by X2; was NOT_SUPPORTED under X1)

claim: RT conditioning does not improve the marginal realism of generated ncRNA relative to type conditioning
supporting_analysis: X1 generation analysis (descriptive, run after likelihoods were frozen): 200 test RTs x 4 samples
result_estimate: 3-mer JSD vs real test ncRNA: T 0.00256, R 0.00428, U 0.02812; R over-generates length (median 178 vs real 156); all arms less structured than real (MFE -25/-39/-43 vs -58.7)
limitations: Temperature-1.0 sampling; marginal composition is not a partner-specificity endpoint; no generated RNA is claimed functional.

claim: Pair counts overstate the independent sample size in this universe by more than two orders of magnitude; the effective number of independent units is what bounds inference
supporting_analysis: Inverse-Simpson n_eff over relatedness components, computed for every fold and every threshold combination
result_estimate: frozen test fold: 4,638 pairs, 357 components, n_eff 14.1; giant component 5,711 pairs (18.5 %); TypeIC1_IC2 has 6,277 pairs at n_eff 1.2
limitations: n_eff is a property of the component-size distribution; it cannot be improved by re-folding the same data.

claim: A leakage-aware split must be joint over both modalities: protein-only or RNA-only blocking cannot control this bipartite relation
supporting_analysis: Split construction plus a partner-multiplicity count re-derived from two independent frozen tables
result_estimate: 96.85 % of RTs have exactly one observed ncRNA partner (max 176); 82.28 % of ncRNAs have exactly one RT partner (max 705); 3.15 % and 17.72 % respectively have more than one. Only the bipartite connected component is closed under both relations.
limitations: The component is indivisible, which is what forces the low n_eff; the trade-off is structural, not a tuning choice.
source_bundle_and_commit: results/embed_g2b_frozen_split @ 15e00b8 and the X2 pair export @ fdf0872, re-derived by scripts/r02_multiplicity.py (both sources agree exactly)

claim: The retrieval and conditional-likelihood effects are not driven by the residual near-duplicate fragment channel
supporting_analysis: Pre-declared near-duplicate sensitivity population (local identity >= 0.90 AND aligned coverage >= 0.30, max-coverage symmetrization), whole affected components excluded
limitations: The ncRNA near-duplicate channel (263 of 2,756 held-out ncRNAs) is accepted and reported, not eliminated.

claim: A confirmatory WITHIN-retron-type partner-specificity test is currently infeasible for this population; the binding constraint is independent components, not model capacity or pair count
supporting_analysis: Within-type feasibility audit under four pre-declared criteria (pool >= 50, >= 30 components, n_eff >= 10, >= 100 T3 pairs)
result_estimate: 2 of 21 types pass (TypeIIIA3, TypeIB1); their TEST-fold n_eff are 3.7 and 4.6; 19 of 21 fail on the n_eff criterion
limitations: An audit, not an experiment; the criteria are ours and could be re-declared, but loosening them would not create independent units.

claim: The R - T advantage replicates under component-blocked cross-fitting with every component evaluated out-of-fold exactly once
supporting_analysis: X2 primary endpoint plus fold heterogeneity and seed replication
limitations: Internal cross-fitted confirmation, not external validation: no new data exist. Cross-fitting buys coverage and robustness, not power (whole-population n_eff 12.5).

claim: The advantage is not FULLY explained by coarse RT lineage: the specific RT beats its own 50 %-identity homolog-group representative
supporting_analysis: X2 arm G (conditioning on the frozen rt_id0.50 cluster representative's ESM-C representation) vs arm R, over three seeds
result_estimate: R - G = -0.00551 [-0.00797, -0.00312], 55.3 % of components; across three seeds -0.00551 / -0.01133 / -0.01560 (sd 0.00506, i.e. sd as large as the primary point estimate)
limitations: DIRECTION ONLY. The sign is stable across seeds but the MAGNITUDE is not determined by this experiment (factor-of-three spread). In the near-duplicate-excluded population the R - G interval includes zero (-0.00210 [-0.00601, +0.00196]). Quote no single-seed magnitude.

claim: Most, but NOT all, of the advantage requires the observed RT-ncRNA correspondence rather than merely conditioning on a realistic RT representation
supporting_analysis: X2 falsification arm P: RTs deranged within retron type during training only; validation and test condition on the true RT
result_estimate: P - T = -0.00590 [-0.01109, -0.00023] - the permutation arm still beats the type label, retaining ~24 % of the full effect; R - P = -0.01880 [-0.02460, -0.01359]
limitations: The permutation control is NOT flat. Any analysis omitting this arm would misattribute that portion of the gain to correct pairing. This qualifies, and does not overturn, C-08.

claim: The observed RT beats stringent counterfactual conditioning: length-matched (C2), nearest ESM-C neighbours (C3) and within the same 50 %-identity RT cluster (C4)
supporting_analysis: X2 counterfactual tiers C2-C4; all four tiers adjudicable (>= 30 components)
dataset_population: out-of-fold eligible pairs: C2 832 / C3 1,073 / C4 451 components
limitations: Marginal at C3/C4 in substance though not in statistics: pair-level discrimination is 52.5 % at C3 and 60.7 % at C4. This is the criterion the frozen gate calls 'yes, marginally'.

claim: Naturally associated RT and ncRNA are functionally compatible, bind, are co-evolved, or are orthogonal to other pairs
supporting_analysis: None. No analysis in this project addresses it and none can with sequence data and natural co-occurrence alone
result_estimate: No estimate exists
limitations: Requires biochemical/structural/functional assay or equivalent independent evidence. Natural pairing is co-occurrence, not demonstrated function.
status: NOT_SUPPORTED (out of scope for the present data)

claim: RT-ncRNA combinations absent from the corpus are incompatible
supporting_analysis: None. Corpus absence is a sampling and detection statement
result_estimate: No estimate exists
limitations: Every ncRNA call in the corpus comes from covariance models (nc_source = 'infernal'); undetected ncRNAs are invisible by construction, disproportionately in divergent lineages.

claim: Model scores can prioritise candidate RT-ncRNA pairs with low predicted cross-reactivity for laboratory testing
supporting_analysis: Designed, not executed: CANDIDATE_SELECTION_DESIGN.md, now constrained by the X2 handoff requirements R1-R6
dataset_population: would be a named, experimentally tractable subset - not yet defined
result_estimate: No score has been computed. F7 is a methods schematic with synthetic values.
limitations: X2 makes the prerequisites harder, not easier: any such score must be built on C3/C4-strength counterfactuals (where the effect is +0.004 / +0.002 nats/nt), must carry seed spread, must report distance-to-training, and must never treat a non-observed pairing as a negative. Pair-level discrimination near chance at C3 forbids a per-pair reading today.

claim: A protein-conditioned RT->ncRNA generator trained in this lab performed family recognition rather than partner recognition, and its contrastive arm degraded the rank statistic while inflating the optimised metric
supporting_analysis: Leave-one-family-out with a row-matched control; InfoNCE arm vs baseline (prior project, audited not re-run)
result_estimate: LOFO row 2AFC 0.5020-0.6474 vs row-matched control 0.6115-0.7419; 78 % of the gap attributed to family identity, 22 % to training volume; InfoNCE: enrichment +0.3692 -> +15.9562 while row 2AFC 0.9532 -> 0.9072 (t = -21.01)
limitations: Different population, split and metric; precedent and engineering, never numeric authority over a frozen bundle.

claim: Contrastive / compatibility modelling remains unauthorised: X2-A would justify DESIGNING such an experiment, but no model of that class has been started
supporting_analysis: Pre-registered escalation rule in LAUNCHER_03 section 7 applied to embed_g2; X2 stop condition in DESIGN.md section 10, adjudicated in DECISION.md
result_estimate: embed_g2 rung-3 difference +0.0298 [-0.0048, +0.0633] failed its declared margin; X2 returns X2-A whose frozen wording 'would justify designing' a compatibility/contrastive experiment, subject to the four inherited design constraints in DECISION.md
limitations: No InfoNCE, dual encoder, compatibility classifier, cross-pair ranking, larger architecture or encoder fine-tuning was started, and none is authorised by this result alone. Work returned for operator review.

claim: Most of the RT-associated predictive gain is explained at the homolog-lineage level rather than by the individual RT
supporting_analysis: X2 decomposition of R - T into G - T (lineage beyond type) and R - G (specific RT beyond lineage)
result_estimate: G - T = -0.01919 [-0.02339, -0.01498] of the total R - T = -0.02470, i.e. ~78 % of the advantage over the broad type label is already captured by the frozen 50 %-identity homolog group; the residual R - G is -0.00551
limitations: This is the central qualification on the chapter's level-2 claim. An analysis reporting only 'RT beats type' measures lineage, not pairing (X2_HANDOFF R4).

claim: Generalisation degrades with distance from the training RTs, and the effect is not demonstrated in the least-similar quartile
supporting_analysis: X2 stratification by cosine between the evaluated RT and the nearest RT the evaluating model saw in training (a prespecified primary axis)
limitations: RT ESM-C embeddings are highly compressed (median nearest-training cosine 0.987, Q1 still above 0.983), so this is a narrow similarity range, not near-vs-far homology. The flatness of R - G localises the gradient to the T arm rather than to relatedness leaking into R - but the limit on extrapolation to unlike RT lineages stands.

claim: The effect is not an artefact of repeated database deposition, and is present in the repeated-event recurrence class
supporting_analysis: X2 prespecified strata over taxonomy breadth, deposition multiplicity and recurrence class
dataset_population: 36 adjudicable R - T strata; recurrence class multiple_species spans 364 components
result_estimate: 28 of 36 strata have the whole 95 % CI below zero, 1 above, 7 spanning zero; 86.1 % favour R. multiple_species -0.02507 (364 components). The effect is mildly WEAKER at high deposition multiplicity (n_physical_loci >= 21: -0.0107)
limitations: Strata are descriptive; the prespecified endpoint remains the pooled component-level contrast.

claim: Component-weighted and pair-weighted counterfactual aggregates differ, and at C3 they differ in SIGN
supporting_analysis: X2 reconciliation between the component-level export (the inference file) and the pair-level export (the join file)
limitations: A weighting effect, not an inconsistency: unweighted pair means let the largest components dominate. It forbids quoting a pair-weighted mean as the effect, and it is why no per-pair biological reading is supported.

claim: The effect holds for the largest RT homolog groups and the largest ncRNA clusters
supporting_analysis: X2 strata by RT homolog-group size and ncRNA cluster size
result_estimate: UNDETERMINED: 22 components (RT homolog groups >100) and 14 components (ncRNA clusters >100), both below the declared 30-component threshold; the ncRNA 21-100 bin spans zero while sizes 1 and 2-5 give ~-0.025
limitations: Absence of sufficient measurement, not measured absence. The effect is carried by small ncRNA clusters and is not demonstrated for the largest ones.
